examples.title: Basic horizontal
examples.description: Three panels side by side: drag a separator to resize its neighbours, double click it to put its panel back to its default size.

examples.title: Nested groups
examples.description: A sidebar beside an editor that sits above a terminal: a group inside a panel joins its parent's model, and each separator resizes its own group only.

examples.title: Collapsible sidebar
examples.description: Drag the sidebar past its minimum and it collapses to a rail; drag it back or press Enter on the separator to expand it.
